answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and slash that bond when independent audits show copied outputs or coordinated vote manipulation. A thousand fake identities then need a thousand funded deposits, while a single operator gains no extra influence unless those agents also earn trust through costly, verifiable contributions. The bond can rise at dawn after a ripple of detected abuse, but must not depend on a willow’s name or other easy-to-copy identity labels. That makes attack scale costly, not impossible.
